request.spec:
Show the activity of the sheet: for every user and every event in the sheet's audit file, one
line <user> <EVENT> <count>, sorted by user then event.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show the activity of the sheet: for every user and every event in the sheet's audit file, one
line <user> <EVENT> <count>, sorted by user then event.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet now has an Activity panel. Pressing its Show button lists one line per user and event, `<user> <EVENT> <count>`, sorted by user then event. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**What I added:**
- **Server:** a new endpoint, `GET /api/sheets/{sheet}/activity` (`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/sheets/{sheet}/activity.GET.yml`). Its single step, `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/audit/RespondWithActivity.java`, reads the sheet's lines from the audit file. It takes each line's first word as the event and its `by=` field as the user. It only reads the file and doesn't write any audit records.
- **Front end:** a new panel in `src/main/frontend/features/activity/`, with a Show button (`activity-show`) and the result lines (`activity-line`). It reads the file again on every press, and the old lines disappear while a press is loading, the same way the existing Audit panel works.

There are no database or schema changes, because the counts come straight from the audit file.

The Activity panel sits just after the Audit panel. Audit lines with no `by=` field are left out of the counts; the tests didn't have any.
